geography.interpretation: The range reflects coordinate-domain versus published-area denominators and boundary uncertainty, not a statistical interval. Spatial containment does not establish coastal/reef representativeness.
geography.figure_change: The full-domain overlay replaces the close-up whose eastern regional tip is clipped. The retained full-domain graphic displays the entire PNG EEZ and selected fixed rectangle; the original article Figure 1 remains separately labeled context.
